text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, it's time for the Tracen
Meet, an internal event
designed to give
students an opportunity to push their
limits. This
time, the competition seems
even more heated than usual.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's a runaway Maruzensky, with Symboli
Rudolf on the chase! Will it
be a dead heat
between these two? They're leaving the
pack behind!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: How lucky are we to be seeing a show like this at school? Oh, they're on the final corner!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky & Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hahhh!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
I-incredible! Simply incredible! Can the
Emperor catch up? Will the
Hot Rod run
away with it?! They're down to the last
100 meters in this
battle of the century!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Sakura Chiyono O leave the stands
with a grimace on her face,
I find myself
wanting to follow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I finally find her, she's absolutely
soaked.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh! T-Trainer! I, um, I'm fine! I was just feeling a little bleh, so I splashed myself with some water!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yeah, or more like... meh? Or "hnghh"? You know, when your heart and head are all like whoo...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That sort of... feeling...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry. To be honest, there's nothing
cutesy about how I feel.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The race was amazing. It felt every bit as
exciting as a G1. The crowd
all held their
breath, overwhelmed by the spectacle...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Watching a race like that, I... I felt like...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I could never stand shoulder to shoulder
with them.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
S-something like that, anyway! Ahaha!
Sorry, I'm not making any
sense!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm... not sure about that.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Th-the thing is, ever since the day I was
captivated by Maruzen, I
started doing
everything I possibly could.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I-I felt like I was growing, and my times did
actually improve. My form
even got
compliments from my instructor...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't much, but I was getting
closer—closer to her! I really
believed that,
but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
After all that hard work, all that
improvement, I realized something!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...We're still worlds apart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She whips the letter from earlier out of her
pocket and tears it to
shreds.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah... S-sorry! I, um... I need to go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She picks up the shreds one by one and
tosses them into the trash
can, then runs
off before I can stop her.

text_block_list.name: Letter
text_block_list.text:
If I could one day run alongside you in
front of thousands, it would be
a dream
come true.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I catch a glimpse of her letter, written in
large, neat, but shaky letters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Over the next few days, I can't stop
worrying about Sakura Chiyono
O, but I
struggle to figure out the best way to
approach her.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You wanted to talk about Chiyo? What's
this all about, Rudolf?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You must already be aware, but... ever
since our scrimmage race, she's
been
feeling down. Hishi Amazon alerted me to
this.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I kept tabs on her for a few days, and it
seemed her mind was
elsewhere. Her face
looked sickly too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Adulation and despair are two sides of the
same coin. Many leave the
academy in
tears over broken dreams... "I'll never
catch up to you."
I've heard those words
countless times.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: As have you, I imagine.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. Ever the worrywart, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's true that she might not be the most
gifted. But she knows that.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That's why she's out on the track every
morning, monitoring her
condition, racking
her brain over how she can improve.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
What I mean is, she stares her weaknesses
in the eye every single day.
It takes a
strong heart to do that... So she'll be just
fine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She has a point. Coming to terms with your
own weaknesses sounds
easy, but
surprisingly few can do it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure some of that tenacity stems from
Chiyono O's own
personality, but the
biggest factor must be...

text_block_list.name: Letter
text_block_list.text:
If I could one day run alongside you in
front of thousands, it would be
a dream
come true.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
She's just not quite ready to take the dive
and get hurt yet. Once she
is, she'll be on
our heels in no time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Forgive my ignorance, then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O might bend, but she
won't break. With just a little
more
courage, she'll be back on her feet running
with a smile.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before I know it, I'm dashing down the
stairs and off looking for her.
